answer: With a Verified email inbox bound by one-time code delivery with revocation on transfer, the account is only as strong as its binding: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The design treats each channel as a wharf: small alone, decisive in aggregate. The relic keeps the process honest and the walnut keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
